name: Night light
description: Warms the screen through hyprsunset while the nightlight flag is on (haseen toggle nightlight), with an optional fixed sunset/sunrise schedule

temperature.description: Colour temperature in K while the night light is on (1000-20000)

sunset.description: HH:MM to turn the night light on every day; empty (or equal to sunrise) = no schedule

sunrise.description: HH:MM to turn the night light off every day
